headline: Bay Bridge-Tunnel and Maritime Museum Logistics
reservation: State park cabins and popular waterfront campsites in St. Michaels or Annapolis require reservations months in advance, typically via state portals. While the bay itself is open water, specific landings, museums, and ferries to Smith or Tangier Islands have separate ticketing systems and seasonal schedules. Always check the official Maryland or Virginia DNR sites for current fishing license requirements and ferry status.

days.title: Heritage and Island Life

stops.name: Smith Island Ferry
stops.detail: Take the scheduled passenger ferry to Maryland's inhabited offshore island to experience the unique waterman culture.

stops.name: J. Millard Tawes Museum
stops.detail: Learn about the seafood industry history and the specific ecology of the lower bay marshlands.

days.driving: Local ferry times vary; allow 45 minutes for the crossing each way.
days.note: Ferry schedules are weather-dependent and highly seasonal; verify times locally.

days.title: Sailing Tradition and Shipyards

stops.name: Chesapeake Bay Maritime Museum
stops.detail: Explore the 18-acre campus featuring the Hooper Strait Lighthouse and historic skipjacks.

stops.name: Tilghman Island
stops.detail: Cross the Knapps Narrows bridge to observe an active commercial fishing fleet in a working waterman village.

days.driving: Allow 1 hour for the round trip between St. Michaels and Tilghman.
days.note: The bridge at Knapps Narrows is one of the busiest; expect brief delays for boat traffic.

days.title: Capitals and Cliffs

stops.name: United States Naval Academy
stops.detail: Walk the historic grounds and visit the chapel; check current public access requirements for visitors.

stops.name: Calvert Cliffs State Park
stops.detail: Hike to the beach to see the massive sandy cliffs known for Miocene-era fossil deposits.

days.driving: Allow 1.5 hours for the drive from Annapolis to the Calvert region.
days.note: Fossil hunting is permitted on the beach, but climbing the cliffs is prohibited for safety.

intel.title: Historic District Constraints
intel.text: Annapolis and St. Michaels have limited street parking; utilize designated municipal garages or satellite lots. Arrive early on weekends to secure spots near the waterfront maritime districts.

intel.title: Island Connectivity
intel.text: Expect limited data speeds and spotty cellular service on Smith and Tangier Islands. Download ferry schedules and walking maps before departing the mainland docks in Crisfield.

intel.title: Peninsula Planning
intel.text: Fuel is readily available in major towns, but ensure you have enough before crossing the 23-mile Chesapeake Bay Bridge-Tunnel. Tolls for the bridge-tunnel are significant; check official rates for your vehicle class.

intel.title: Tide and Wind Factors
intel.text: Paddling and sailing conditions depend heavily on the bay's tides and prevailing winds. Check local marine forecasts and tide charts before renting small watercraft in the mid-bay.

intel.title: Public Beach Availability
intel.text: Access to Calvert Cliffs beach requires a hike of approximately two miles; verify trail status after heavy rain. Sandy Point State Park often reaches capacity early on summer weekends; check for closure alerts.

plan.arrival: Pick up rental at PHF or BWI, and drive to your first waterfront base, allowing for bridge-tunnel tolls and seasonal traffic.
plan.vehicle: Standard cars are suitable for this paved itinerary; check rental rules for travel across the Bay Bridge-Tunnel.
plan.goldenHour: The Annapolis City Dock provides a classic view for sunset as boats return to 'Ego Alley,' with seasonal shifts in light quality.
